title: A ring or arc gets a full turn, forever, when Rotation is added
goal: In the spinner walkthrough, adding Rotation to a ring or arc arrives as 0 to 360 degrees with Repeat on Forever, because that is what a spinner is. Today every shape arrives as a small swing back and forth, so a person has to retype both ends and the repeat before anything spins.
notes: Mock docs/design/mocks/pages/icon-loop-wt.html step 3 #motNote: Rotation arrives at 0 to 360 with Repeat on Forever when the shape is a ring. Code: LayerMotion.starting(.rotation, on:) in Sources/PhotonzCore/LayerMotion.swift ~1206, currently -12..12 foreverThereAndBack for every layer. Found by a-spinner-can-turn-about-the-middle-of-the-artbo.
acceptance: Adding Rotation to an ellipse or an open arc path in an icon frame arrives as From 0, To 360, Repeat Forever, at Next defaults
Other shapes keep the swing they arrive with today
A walk adds Rotation to an arc and reads 0, 360 and Forever on the row

log.note: Pre-build review: the mock (icon-loop-wt.html step 3) also says Linear and draws a 1.2 s turn, so those arrive too; pivot stays Its centre as step 3 draws it. Scoped to layers inside an icon frame because tutorial-two-parts-out-of-phase, motion-timing-strip and others put a second swing on a loose ellipse and expect -12..12. 'Arc' = ellipse annotation, open path with a bend, or a bent path with a partial trim; a whole closed curve (bell, clapper) still swings. Built: Layer.isRingOrArc + LayerMotion.starting(_:on:inIcon:) in LayerMotion.swift, EditorState.addMotion passes iconFrameID(containing:). Tests: SpinnerRotationTests (6). Walk a-ring-or-arc-arrives-spinning-walk passes; motion-loop-preview, spinner-turns-about-the-artboard, forever-spinner-keeps-its-own-pace re-run green. Full suite 13218 green. Looked at 1-arc-sc.png: row reads 0 to 360 over 1.2s, Linear, strip shows a 1200 ms turn repeating. Left rough: motion-loop-preview-walk's narrative speaks of two swings with a lag, and its ellipse now spins instead; its checks still pass and no person sees that text, so not filed.

Rotation on a ring or arc in an icon frame arrives as 0 to 360, Linear, Forever, 1.2 s a turn (LayerMotion.starting inIcon + Layer.isRingOrArc); other shapes keep the swing. Verified by SpinnerRotationTests, the new a-ring-or-arc-arrives-spinning-walk at Next defaults, three neighbouring walks and the full suite (13218 green).
